title: Pairfy: A P2P e-commerce protocol based on trust rating and blind mediators

ms.promise:
・kubernetes repository: Folders, files, scripts and manifests for the operation of kubernetes app cluster configured for development and production environment with load balancer.
・Frontend-main: Main front-end service of the dapp which aims to enable the visitor or community to interact with the products published by the community.
・Frontend-seller: Secondary front-end service used only by the sellers. Allows to manage the seller account, product inventory and product slots. (seller dashboard).
・Service-users: C.R.U.D service for the management of user accounts.
ms.criteria:
1. kubernetes repository: The content of the repository is sufficient to deploy the basic services of a Kubernetes application and the README.md must contain the steps for the installation on Linux. It must contain manifests for development and production environments with load balancer.

2. Frontend-main: 
 a. The service must display a main page with header, banner and product grid. The header 
 must contain the geographic location button indicating the language and flag of the visitor's country. 
 It should also contain the button to use Cardano wallet.
 b. The interface must be responsive

ms.promise:
・Location service: It allows you to identify the area code where the visitor or potential buyer is located to show the products published in their area.
・Page view for negotiation sessions: It is a frontend page that allows bilateral communication between the seller, the buyer and eventually the mediators.
・Live chat websockets service: It is a backend service that allows bilateral communication via websocket in which the seller, buyer and eventually the mediators participate.
・Mediator account service: service for the administration of mediator accounts.
ms.criteria:
・Location service: takes the visitor's public address and determines the ISO 3166-1 code to show products from their area.
・Page view for negotiation sessions: The buyer must be able to open a negotiation session and communicate with the seller. The mediator must be able to communicate in the event of an appeal.
・Live chat websockets service: The backend service responds to the request for a negotiation session, allowing the establishment of a persistence-free web socket instance that allows bilateral communication and eventually that of the mediator.
